snippet.title: Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant (Tiệm Phở của Anh Hai) - Official Trailer | A Vietnamese Horror Game
snippet.description:
Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant is a story-driven horror game insprired by Vietnamese culture and real events, made with Godot Engine. Step into the shoes of Anh Hai, a new pho restaurant owner in a seemingly peaceful village in Dan Phuong District, Hanoi.

🎮 Add it to your itch.io collection now: https://marisa0704.itch.io/brother-hais-pho-restaurant
Steam Release: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247820/Brother_Hais_Pho_Restaurant/
Soundtracks: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt0R98w2RlR3KyUphvOH1K2CtxR_Fbf6s

Song used in video: Quê tôi - Thùy Chi
